# Frozen legacy swatch compatibility inputs

Generated using actual app/tests source archived from `4ae91ca62c2ec244b818d6486e989dc925c29702`. The synthetic uniform 30×32 pattern has a pinned 30×32 hat and an unbound 5g/100-stitch yarn swatch. The project stores progress and notes; the trial ZIP saves a synthetic 26×28 swatch for density preview.

No physical item was made or measured. These files exercise old-format recovery and evidence binding; they are not G4 evidence and contain no private images or data.
